notes: Cross-verse consistency. The בְּ of נגע בְּ is unrepresented in the chapter's nine other occurrences (vv. 5, 7, 10, 12, 19, 21, 22, 23, 27) because the ASV writes a bare object (rule 40); v.11 alone folded it, with its resumptive suffix, into whomsoever. The suffix is likewise unrepresented in the two nearest parallels, v.12 (which) and v.18 (whom), under rule 22. The unit's source head also moves from the relative to כֹל, matching v.9's identical כֹּל + אֲשֶׁר fusion and the five כָל הַ → whosoever units.
